source_text: I was thinking, it might be nice to whiz through the remaining-nontopology problems as well, I have doubts if the one-week-of-codex could do both the nontopology and the topology problems, but if we got both moving again then I am pretty confident we could eventually get to the end.  I don't think we need the same kind of audit on nontopology.  The real problem there is that I built a complex APM machine and still haven't gotten any convincing evidence that it works.  Therefore, I am thinking the best thing to do would just be to complete the problem sets with Codex and then come back and try to operationalise the mining and "transfer" for GLM 5.2 / 5.3 in a subsequent round, without continuing to deal with the frustrations that the APM machine was causing me.
